Summary: Scanner emits a numeric score (e.g. +54 NEUTRAL) when Yahoo intraday indicators (VWAP / RSI / EMA) are partially unavailable. The UI does not enumerate which indicator inputs were absent from the score.
RootCause: fullNseScanner.ts score computation starts at 50 and adds/subtracts for available indicators. If EMA trend is computable from daily bars but RSI/VWAP are null the score deviates from 50 with partial inputs.
UserImpact: Score appears meaningful when some inputs are missing. User cannot distinguish full-indicator score from partial-indicator score without inspecting hover-tooltip reasons.
TradingImpact: None — score is tagged canDriveSignals=false via shouldDemoteSignal(). Score never enters F&O or swing admission. Provenance is secondary_analytics.
RoadmapOwner: Prompt 33 (scanner / candle coverage / Yahoo containment defects)
AcceptanceTest: When indicator inputs are absent: score renders as null or N/A (not numeric), OR score renders with a visible count of inputs used (e.g. "3/6 inputs"). canDriveSignals=false enforced.

Summary: Scanner footer states ""Yahoo Finance is a display-only fallback... never used for signals or paper trading."" This is correct for trading decisions but Yahoo daily candles are used for RSI/EMA computation in the scanner score. The score is informational (canDriveSignals=false) but the footer implies Yahoo is only a price fallback not an indicator input.
RootCause: Footer was written before Yahoo indicator enrichment was documented as the primary indicator source.
UserImpact: User may believe Kite-only data powers scanner scores. In fact RSI/EMA/VWAP in scanner rows are Yahoo-derived when Kite intraday is unavailable.
TradingImpact: None — canDriveSignals=false enforced in code. Indicators do not enter trading decisions.
AcceptanceTest: Footer accurately states: ""Scanner indicators (RSI / EMA / VWAP) are computed from Yahoo daily and intraday data (~15 min delayed). Live Kite data supplies prices and OHLC only. Indicator-derived scores are informational and never drive F&O or swing paper trading."""
